hero_subhead: Most prop traders fail evaluations. TradeBlade puts a small live hedge behind your eval so every blow‑up feeds your real account. The math works because failure is the most common outcome — and you’re on the right side of it.
hero_supports: NQ on your prop accounts · MNQ hedge in your own brokerage account · 2-Step & Straight-to-Funded accounts · Built for NinjaTrader 8.
engine_tagline:
Your eval will probably fail. Your hedge makes that profitable.
Every trade on your prop account is matched by an opposite trade in your own live brokerage account — one MNQ for each NQ on the evaluation. Eval blows up? Hedge profits. Eval passes? You collect the payout. Either way, you’re recouping capital across every cycle.
engine_blows_desc: Your live hedge captures real gains from the sim failure
engine_passes_desc: You take a small hedge loss but collect a real payout
engine_repeat_desc: Failures are common & profitable. Payouts are rare but still net positive.
engine_cta_sub: Interactive hedge profit calculator — plug in your own numbers and see what each outcome pays.
features_sub: TradeBlade doesn’t ask you to plan every trade. It trades on its own ladder, which sets the size, target and stop of every trade — with zero emotion, zero hesitation, and zero deviation.
features_hero_p1:
No levels to set. No stops to drag. No size to pick.
Arm the pair, press BUY or SELL — TradeBlade does the rest.
features_hero_p2: On the evaluation you trade 1, 2 or 3 NQ with one MNQ hedge per NQ, chosen once in the setup wizard. Once funded, TradeBlade runs a 3-6-7 MNQ hedge ladder. The stop and target of every trade are placed at the broker with the entry, before the first tick moves.
feature_1_desc: Entry is Direct Entry: arm the pair, then press BUY or SELL. TradeBlade enters the NQ trade on your prop account and the opposite MNQ trade in your brokerage account together. Long or short. Your call — there is nothing else to set.
feature_2_desc: TradeBlade’s ladder sets every trade’s stop and target, and both are placed at the broker with the entry. No moving stops. No “just a little more.” No revenge widening after a loss. The same plan executes — every single time.
feature_3_title: 🛡️ Daily Loss Limits That Actually Hold
feature_3_desc: You set a daily max loss. TradeBlade enforces it — hard. When you hit the limit, trading stops. No override button. No “one more trade.” The session is done. Your account lives to fight another day.
feature_4_desc: Define your session window — London open, NY open, power hour, whatever fits your edge. Outside that window, TradeBlade is flat. No overnight surprises. No low-volume traps. Trades only fire during the hours you trust.
feature_5_desc: See everything TradeBlade is doing — live, on your NinjaTrader chart. Active positions, P&L, daily limits remaining. 1-second updates. Full transparency. Zero guessing about what the robot is thinking.
feature_6_desc: You don’t need iron willpower. You don’t need to fight the urge to revenge trade. You just need one rule: only trade with TradeBlade. It handles the size, the stop and the target. You press BUY or SELL. That’s the deal.
arch_sub: No tuner at launch. Clear, inspectable flow from the Strategy to the HUD.
arch_1_desc: Entries/exits with session‑aware window, loss‑limit lockouts, and 1‑second publishing.
arch_2_desc: In‑process store with TTL that holds the latest snapshot and per‑session HWM.
arch_3_desc: Lightweight identity shim that normalizes keys and forwards DTOs into the bus.
arch_4_desc: Visualizer reads the bus and renders a crisp, zero‑flicker dashboard on your chart.
ease_title: New to automation? You’re not alone.
ease_p1: Most TradeBlade users have never run a trading robot before. That’s fine — you don’t need to write a single line of code, and there are no levels, stops, targets or sizes to set. The setup wizard walks you through your accounts once; after that you arm a pair and press BUY or SELL. TradeBlade handles the rest.
ease_p2: Got questions? Our AI assistant is trained on every detail of the platform and available 24/7. And if you need a real person, I’m here. This is a one-person operation, so response times vary — but every user matters, and every message gets read.

faq_1_a: TradeBlade is a hedge execution engine for NinjaTrader 8. Each prop-firm account is traded against an opposite hedge in your own live brokerage account, so a failed evaluation still pays. TradeBlade trades on its own ladder, which sets every trade’s size, target and stop. It’s not a signal service: you choose when to enter by pressing BUY or SELL, and TradeBlade handles everything after that.
faq_2_a: Yes. TradeBlade is built exclusively for NinjaTrader 8 and runs inside it. You’ll need an active NinjaTrader 8 installation with a connected data feed, your prop-firm accounts, and your own brokerage account for the hedge.
faq_3_q: Can I set my own levels, stops or size?
faq_3_a: No. TradeBlade trades on its own ladder, which sets the size, target and stop of every trade. On the evaluation you choose 1, 2 or 3 NQ in the setup wizard, with one MNQ hedge per NQ; once funded, TradeBlade runs a 3-6-7 MNQ hedge ladder. Entry is Direct Entry: arm the pair and press BUY or SELL. The stop and target are placed at the broker with the entry.
faq_4_q: Does TradeBlade pick trades for me?
faq_4_a: No. TradeBlade doesn’t pick trades or send signals. You decide when to enter and in which direction. TradeBlade handles everything after that — the size, stop and target from its ladder, the opposite hedge in your brokerage account, and daily loss limits that can’t be overridden.
faq_5_a: The hedge is the core of TradeBlade, not an option. Every trade on your prop-firm account is paired with an opposite MNQ trade in your own live brokerage account — one MNQ for each NQ on the evaluation. When you fail the eval (which happens to most traders most of the time), the hedge captures real profit from that failure. Over many cycles, the math turns the most common outcome — eval failure — into a net positive. Use the calculator to see how it works with your numbers.
faq_6_a: NQ (Nasdaq-100 futures) on the prop side and MNQ (Micro Nasdaq-100 futures) on the hedge side — no other instruments. On the evaluation you trade 1, 2 or 3 NQ with one MNQ hedge per NQ; once funded, the hedge follows a 3-6-7 MNQ ladder.
faq_7_q: How does TradeBlade enforce daily loss limits?
faq_7_a: Hard. When your daily P&L hits the limit you set, TradeBlade flattens all positions and stops trading for the session. There’s no override button. No “one more trade.” The session is done. This is the single most important feature for account survival — and the one most traders can’t enforce on themselves.
faq_8_q: Can I see what TradeBlade is doing in real time?
faq_8_a: Yes. The HUD (heads-up display) renders directly on your NinjaTrader chart and updates every second. You can see active positions, P&L, daily limits remaining, and session status. Full transparency — you always know exactly what the engine is doing and why.
faq_9_a: Any broker that connects through NinjaTrader 8. This includes NinjaTrader Brokerage, Interactive Brokers, Dorman Trading, Phillip Capital, and others. If your broker supports NinjaTrader 8, TradeBlade will work.
faq_10_q: Do I need to be at my computer while TradeBlade trades?
faq_10_a: TradeBlade runs on your NinjaTrader 8 instance, so the platform needs to be running with a live data connection. You enter each trade by pressing BUY or SELL; after that the stop and target sit at the broker and TradeBlade manages both sides. Many traders run NinjaTrader on a VPS (virtual private server) so it stays connected even when their own computer is off, and the phone app lets you watch, arm, enter or flatten your pairs from anywhere.
faq_11_q_v2: What if I want to stop?
faq_11_a_v2: You can stop using TradeBlade at any time. There is no subscription to cancel, no contract, no lock-in period and no cancellation fee. Events that finished before you stop are billed with your next charge. If you believe something was billed in error, email us within 30 days of the charge and we’ll make it right.
faq_12_a: TradeBlade never touches your funds. Your money stays in your brokerage account, controlled by your broker. TradeBlade only sends trade instructions through NinjaTrader’s API — it has no access to deposits, withdrawals, or account transfers. Your broker handles all custody and regulatory compliance.
faq_13_a: TradeBlade keeps a record of every order and fill on the accounts you select, their balances, and its own actions and log files, and sends it to us so we can support you and fix problems. We call it the Record. The Record is required and has no opt-out: before TradeBlade opens for the first time it shows you exactly what is sent and what is never sent, and you accept that screen or press Exit. TradeBlade never sees your logins or passwords and never touches your funds. Details are in our Privacy Policy.

cta_card_p1: Jesse Livermore made $100 million in a single trade during the 1929 crash — roughly $2 billion today. He was the greatest trader who ever lived. He read markets like no one before or since. He had every edge, every instinct, every lesson written in scar tissue.
cta_card_p3: Not because he lost his edge. Because he couldn’t stop himself from trading without rules. The man who understood markets better than anyone alive couldn’t solve the one problem that kills every trader: himself.
cta_card_p4: This book is about that problem — and what it takes to survive long enough to find out if you actually have an edge.
